findings.title: An undecryptable sealed TOTP secret answers 500 internal_error, not a 401-class refusal
findings.mechanism: POST /api/v1/auth/mfa/challenge propagates secretbox's 'cipher: message authentication failed' as an unhandled error. It fails CLOSED (no session, nothing leaked) and the server log names the cause, but the operator-facing signal after a restore with the wrong or missing MFA_KEY_KEK is 'an unexpected error occurred'.
findings.blast_radius: every second-factor login on a host restored with the wrong KEK; also the exact symptom an operator meets when the config archive was not restored alongside the dump

findings.title: The api boots and reports /readyz 200 on a KEK that cannot decrypt anything it stores
findings.mechanism: MFA_KEY_KEK is validated for SHAPE at boot (base64 of 32 bytes) and never against a stored ciphertext, so a wrong-KEK restore looks healthy until the first MFA login.

findings.title: restore.sh stops api, search and frontend BEFORE it validates the archive
findings.mechanism: a tampered or unreadable dump takes the site down and then refuses, changing nothing. The refusal is correct; the outage before it is avoidable — the archive is validated a few lines later.

findings.title: A corrupt .gz dies on gzip's own message with no [restore] ERROR line
findings.mechanism: the `*.gz)` branch is `gzip -dc … > $HOST_TMP` with no `|| die`; set -e kills the script, so the operator reads 'gzip: invalid compressed data--crc error' and nothing that says the restore refused or that nothing was dropped.

findings.title: B2's native download host for this account's cluster is NXDOMAIN
findings.mechanism: b2_authorize_account returns downloadUrl https://f005.backblazeb2.com, which does not resolve (f000/f001/f004 do). Any native-protocol retrieval — b2 CLI, rclone's b2 backend — fails with UnknownHost. The S3 endpoint s3.us-east-005.backblazeb2.com resolves, which is why A36's rclone recipe uses `type = s3`. An operator following a native-B2 recipe would discover this only during a recovery.

findings.title: Search returns the public video only; the private one is indexed but ineligible
findings.mechanism: search.documents carries both restored videos, the private one with eligible=false. 'Search returns both videos' is only true once the second is eligible — verified by flipping it public (2 hits) and back (1 hit).
